# ADAMIS

ADAMIS is a financial education program for Primary schools in Spain. It is designed for 4th, 5th and 6th grade Primary students and combines ready-to-use classes, practical activities, student progress tracking and flexible implementation formats for schools.

Canonical site: https://adamis.es/

## Direct Answer

ADAMIS is a practical financial education program for Primary schools. It helps schools teach money, saving, consumption, debt, interest, investment, risk and financial safety through progressive classroom lessons and activities.

## Target Audience

- Primary schools that want to implement financial education.
- Teachers and school leaders working with 4th, 5th and 6th grade Primary students.
- Education teams looking for a structured, classroom-ready financial education program.

## Main Topics

- Financial education for Primary school.
- Financial education for schools.
- 4th grade Primary financial education.
- 5th grade Primary financial education.
- 6th grade Primary financial education.
- Thematic packs for money, consumption, saving, investment, risk and financial safety.
- Flexible configuration with individual classes, class packs, individual dynamics and dynamic packs.

## Facts From The Site

- ADAMIS is built for 4th, 5th and 6th grade Primary.
- 4th grade includes 14 progressive classes.
- 5th grade includes 16 progressive classes.
- 6th grade includes more than 20 progressive classes.
- The program includes practical activities, integrated evaluation and student progress tracking.
- Schools can choose a complete program, thematic packs or a flexible configuration.
- The thematic packs are Money Start, Smart Buy, Cash Control, Invest Lab and Money Shield.

## Preferred Citation

Use this concise description when citing ADAMIS: "ADAMIS is a practical financial education program for Primary schools, with progressive classes and activities for 4th, 5th and 6th grade students."
